zutaten: Jam and clotted cream, to serve
zubereitung: Heat oven to 220C / 200C fan / gas 7. Tip flour and baking powder into a bowl with butter.
Rub butter in with your fingers until mixture looks like fine crumbs, then stir in sugar.
Warm milk gently and add vanilla extract. Stir into flour mixture to make a soft dough.
Roll out dough to 4cm thickness and stamp out rounds. Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
